condition: The pandas 2.2.3 wheel for Python 3.10 on aarch64 Linux was packaged wrong: it bundles musl .so files for every Python version, so auto-patchelf fails when installing with nix and uv2nix.
workaround: Pass auto-patchelf --ignore-missing for libc.musl-aarch64.so.1, or build pandas from source.
